review.notes: Source-backed sheet replacements and progression. External prerequisites, optional replacements, companions, complex combat effects and extra named subchoices manual.

features.name: Eldritch Strikes
features.description:
At 1st level, an elemental warrior picks an element type: earth, fire, ice, lightning, water, or wind and he gains [Arcane Strike](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/feats/combat-feats/arcane-strike-combat) as a bonus feat. She does not need to meet its prerequisites. The bonus damage is of the element type chosen. The elemental warrior uses his warrior levels as his caster levels for this ability. The elemental warrior may take [Riving Strike](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/feats/combat-feats/riving-strike-combat) feat, without needing to meet the prerequisites.

This ability replaces combat defences.
Sheet support: conditional combat bonuses, temporary forms, equipment, prerequisites and any extra subchoices are applied manually using existing sheet entries.

features.name: Fearful Might
features.description:
At 2nd level, an elemental warrior gains a +1 bonus on Intimidate checks to demoralize/antagonize a foe. This bonus increases to +2 at 6th level and by an additional 1 every four warrior levels thereafter to a maximum of +5 at 18th level.

This ability replaces combat offenses.
Sheet support: conditional combat bonuses, temporary forms, equipment, prerequisites and any extra subchoices are applied manually using existing sheet entries.

features.name: Elemental Strike
features.description:
At 4th level, whenever the elemental warrior damages a target with an attack augmented by Arcane Strike, the attack deals an additional 1d4 points of damage of the elemental warrior’s element type chosen. At 10th and 16th level, this damage increases by another 1d4.

This ability replaces physical resilience.
